example: Article: Apple recently announced their much anticipated launch of the Mac Pro and the Pro Display XDR. With the introduction of the new hardware, Apple also unveiled the capabilities of their new Afterburner card, which is the first of its kind in the industry. This powerful new card will enable professionals to edit 8K video in real time, as well as allowing them to manipulate and create 3D models with ease.
